title: Introduce SLO Gentle Rewind + Prefetch Coordinator (hotfix)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: After the outage on 2026-02-16 we observed repeated oscillations when tenants were force-evicted and then rapidly reinstated. Cold KV misses + global rehydration spikes triggered cascading soft-evictions and SLO blips. This hotfix implements a two-part mitigation: (1) a 'gentle rewind' SLO limiter that applies a time-limited, decaying backoff to aggressive reopen attempts for recently-evicted tenants; and (2) a Prefetch Coordinator that attaches an optional lightweight prefetch intent to a tenant reinstatement to warm KV prefixes and reduce cold-path latency. Goals: reduce oscillation count, avoid rapid reopen/evict churn, and improve tail latency during tenant warmups.

review_comments: Marcus Chen (review): Can we bound memory usage for prefetch intents? If many tenants request prefetch simultaneously we could accidentally hold large KV snapshots. Suggest adding per-node active-intent cap and backpressure path.
Author (Aisha): Added per-node active_intent_limit with LRU eviction of least-recent intents; documented limit as 200 by default. See services/prefetch/coordinator.go lines 78-122.
Lena Ortiz (review): The rewind limiter needs a safety opt-out for dedicated capacity customers who require immediate reinstatement. Please add a policy flag and tests.
Author (Aisha): Added tenant-level policy bypass when tenant.config.allow_instant_reopen == true; added unit test and linear link ENG-4219.
Samir Rao (approve): Verified behaviour in staging with 20 tenants toggling reinstatement rapidly; oscillation rate dropped ~6x and p99 warmup latency fell ~45%. Approving for merge after CI passes.

release_notes: Hotfix: gentle rewind SLO limiter and optional prefetch coordinator to stabilize reinstatement churn and reduce cold-path latency. Default behavior is opt-in via tenant policy; enabled for SaaS tier as emergency mitigation.
testing: Unit tests added for rewind_limiter and prefetch intent state; integration test simulates eviction->reopen churn with and without prefetch; staged rollout to canary (10%) then full cluster. Staging results: oscillation events reduced from 18/min to 3/min, aggregate p99 warmup latency reduced by 45%.
backout_plan: Revert head branch with emergency revert PR if regressions are observed. Detailed operator steps in docs/operational/playbooks/gentle_rewind.md: disable slo_gentle_rewind via config flag, set prefetch.active_intent_limit=0 to disable prefetch, and run tenant state reconciliation to clear intents.
notes_for_oncall: If reopen rates remain high after deployment, set slo.rewind.backoff_base_ms to a higher value and enable tenant-level bypass to debug a single customer. Watch metrics slo_gentle_rewind_rewinds and prefetch_intents_active_count. Use /debug/prefetch/intents endpoint to inspect outstanding intents.
